string-array.name: safety_tips_titles
string-array.item: Keep a verbal code word with family

string-array.name: safety_tips_descriptions
string-array.item: Let a trusted contact know where you are, especially on unfamiliar routes.
If a situation feels wrong, leave immediately rather than second-guessing yourself.
A charged phone means you can always reach the SOS button and your contacts.
Add at least 2–3 trusted people in the Contacts section so alerts reach someone fast.
Prefer well-lit, populated streets when travelling alone after dark.
Agree on a simple code word with family that signals you need help without alarming others nearby.
